dvids.title: Deployed Resiliency Counseling While at Sea
dvids.desc: U.S. Navy deployments routinely test Sailors with physical and mental demands that come with shipboard life. Sailors have many resources available to them to include the Deployment Resiliency Counselor (DRC), to help them cope with underway challenges and stress.
